signals.name: charsAppended
signals.quantity: total characters appended to the StringBuilder during CachedOutputStream.writeCacheTo(StringBuilder, String) — measures the unbounded content materialized at the sink
signals.storage: ThreadLocal<long[]> in V1Counters: index 0 = StringBuilder.length() at method entry, index 1 = chars appended (exit length - entry length)
signals.reset: V1Counters.reset() called in V1Guidance.getInput() before each execution

plans.retention: Primary: retain inputs where charsAppended exceeds the current best (higher allocation at the sink). Secondary (while charsAppended is zero — signal flat because input has not yet crossed the 1024-byte spill threshold): retain inputs that are longer than the longest saved, so the search grows toward the threshold. Once any input crosses 1024 bytes and reaches the sink, charsAppended becomes non-zero and the primary criterion takes over.
mutation: byte-level: random byte flip at a random position; random insertion of 1-8 random bytes; random deletion of 1-8 bytes

repetition [R45(a)]: select a random region [start, start+len) of the input and repeat it k times in-place, with k chosen so the result approaches maxInputSize (10240); special case: double the entire input. Grows a 1-byte seed to 1025+ bytes in ~11 mutations.

dictionary [R45(b)]: tokens from the code on the attack path — 0x0A (newline), 0x0D (carriage return), 0x5B '[', 0x5D ']', 'Content: ' (toString prefix), 'cos' (temp file prefix), 'tmp' (temp file suffix) — inserted or overwritten at random positions. These are single syntactic units from the source, not assembled triggering inputs.
no encoder [R45(c)]: the input is raw bytes with no format checks, checksums, or compression; any bytes reach the sink once the total length exceeds the spill threshold
